pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal patches with predominantly smooth to slightly rounded edge gradients. Dark reddish-brown regions are larger and more contiguous on the upper neck and flank, reducing in spatial area and pixel contrast toward the ventral region.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of cream-colored pathways separating dark patches. Junction nodes are primarily tri-point intersections with a consistent pixel thickness of 5-10 pixels in high-contrast areas, widening significantly at the lateral-ventral transition.
